verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms a broad ecosystem of existing ROS nodes/drivers that developers can reuse (ros2-comm-7, ros2-comm-9), and docs mention installable 'message packages' via the standard install (ros2-docs-44), implying a package-based distribution model. However, the pack lacks first-party documentation of an actual package registry, index, or discovery/install workflow (e.g. rosdep, apt package feeds, ROS Index) for hardware drivers/behaviors. Missing for 10: explicit docs on the package registry/index, install/discovery tooling (rosdep, colcon, apt repos), and examples of pulling a specific hardware driver package.
